searchPlaceholder: Search documents or blocks, or paste a block ref / link / ID
pickHint: ↑ ↓ to select · Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
disabled: The KMind Palace plugin is disabled. This tab comes back when you re-enable it.
sourceTitle: Which notebook goes on the bookshelf?
sourceHint: Pick a notebook to shelve its top-level documents, or expand one and pick a document to shelve its sub-documents. The books follow your document tree automatically.
aiSaved: KMind Palace: AI model settings saved
aiStyleDesc: Turns a note into a small scene at a spot in the palace. The more absurd, the easier to remember.
aiTextDesc: "SiYuan AI" uses the model set up in Settings → AI. You can also use your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, local Ollama, etc.).
aiBaseDesc: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, usually ending in /v1. Local or LAN addresses are requested directly from the page.
aiKeyDesc: Stored only in this plugin's config file. Never written to palace data or included in palace exports.
aiImageDesc: Draw an illustration for a mnemonic story (needs an endpoint that supports /images/generations).
aiImageBaseDesc: Leave empty to use the text endpoint above.
aiImageModelDesc: e.g. gpt-image-1, dall-e-3, or a model offered by a compatible endpoint.
aiTestDesc: Ask the text model for a short reply using the current values (no need to save first).
aiVisionDesc: Used to recognize items from photos: a model that can see images (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, qwen-vl-plus, glm-4v), using the API base URL and key above. If left empty and stories use a custom endpoint, the story model is used.
socialServerDesc: Server for adding friends and visiting each other's palaces (e.g. https://palace.example.com). Leave empty to turn visiting off. After changing it, start over in Friends.
socialServerBad: The address must start with http:// or https://
socialServerSaved: Visiting server saved. Reopen KMind Palace to apply.
welcome: KMind Palace is installed 🏝 Click the palace icon on the right of the top bar (or press ⌥⇧M) to open it. A short guide shows up the first time.
